# Catch3

> Catch3 is a C++17 test framework by Progmasoft. It keeps the test cases, assertions and sections written for Catch2,
> and adds a runner of its own, property tests, mocks, snapshots and structured results. It is a compiled library;
> its headers work in C++17 and later. Files that come from Catch2 keep the Boost Software License 1.0; files
> Progmasoft writes are under the GNU LGPL, version 3 or later. Catch3 is not an official Catch2 release and is not
> endorsed by Catch2's maintainers.

The releases are at https://catch3.uk/releases/; the newest is listed first there and on GitHub.

- Familiar tests: test cases, assertions, sections, matchers, generators, listeners and benchmarks keep working.
- The runner: tests run in parallel worker processes, a crash or a hang ends one test and not the run, failures are
  retried to tell flaky and order-dependent tests apart, flaky tests go to quarantine, a history drives time limits,
  ordering, incremental runs and replay, and reports come out as console, JUnit, JSON and traces. It imports the
  results of other test frameworks (JUnit, xUnit, TRX, TAP, CTRF) and keeps per-test coverage (LLVM source-based
  coverage and gcov).
- Property tests: values from a reproducible seed, a predicate checked over many trials, and a failing input shrunk
  to a smaller counterexample.
- Mocks of virtual interfaces and of free functions behind a seam, checking call counts, arguments and order.
- Text snapshots in files the test chooses, and a public result model with a deterministic JUnit XML writer.
- Builds: Bazel is the main build; CMake, Meson, Xmake and Premake project files are kept beside it. An installed
  Catch3 is found with `find_package(Catch3 CONFIG REQUIRED)` and linked as `Catch3::Catch3` or
  `Catch3::Catch3WithMain`; headers are included as `<Progmasoft/Catch3/...>`.
- The `catch3` command reads test results and reports them, imports the results of other frameworks and runs test
  binaries. It is not in the published releases; its installers are described at
  https://catch3.uk/download.

## Pages

- [Home](https://catch3.uk/): what Catch3 adds, a property in a few lines, the builds and the licences.
- [Download](https://catch3.uk/download): the page of each system (`?os=linux`, `?os=macos`, `?os=windows`), the
  catch3 command, and the library from source.
- [Releases](https://catch3.uk/releases/): every release, newest first, with its notes.

## Documentation

- [Catch3 additions](https://github.com/Progmasoft/catch3/blob/devel/docs/progmasoft-catch3.md): properties,

- [Tutorial](https://github.com/Progmasoft/catch3/blob/devel/docs/tutorial.md)

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/Progmasoft/catch3): source and issues; development happens on the devel branch.
- [Progmasoft](https://progmasoft.com/llms.txt): the other projects of Progmasoft.
